items.q1: Can agencies brand the client experience under their own domain?
items.a1: Yes. EventFrame is built specifically for wedding studios and planners. Your clients see your agency name, logo, and subdomain (e.g., yourstudio.eventframe.io).
items.q2: How does live guest moderation work during the reception?
items.a2: Guests scan a QR code on the table to post photos and well-wishes from their mobile browser. The studio or bridal party can approve or decline messages in real-time from the dashboard before they appear on the ballroom projector.
items.q3: Do guests need to install an app to RSVP or post photos?
items.a3: No app download is required. Everything runs in the mobile browser with responsive, lightweight, touch-optimized interfaces.
items.q4: Can couples edit their wedding pages directly?
items.a4: Yes. Couples receive a secure event access PIN that gives them access to their private dashboard to view RSVPs, download guest lists, and moderate celebration messages.
items.q5: How does EventFrame pay-per-event pricing work?
items.a5: EventFrame operates on a pure pay-per-event model. You pay once per wedding event, which includes 12 full calendar months of access. There are no mandatory monthly subscriptions, no bulk credits, and no recurring commitments. User signup and draft creation are always free.

faqs.q1: How does EventFrame replace disconnected wedding planning tools?
faqs.a1: Instead of combining third-party RSVP forms, generic stationery websites, and disjointed photo-sharing apps, EventFrame unifies client invitations, custom RSVP questionnaires, attendee management, and live ballroom reception displays in one elegant studio platform.
faqs.q2: Can our studio manage dozens of weddings in one season?
faqs.a2: Yes. The agency dashboard gives you a calendar schedule and instant access to all active client events. You can switch between couples in seconds, duplicate event settings, and export attendee data.
faqs.q3: Can client couples access their own wedding dashboard?
faqs.a3: Yes. Planners can share a private couple portal link protected with an event access PIN. Couples can review RSVP attendance lists and moderate live banquet messages without accessing other agency clients.
faqs.q4: Does EventFrame require guests to download an app?
faqs.a4: No app download is required. Guests simply tap an invitation link or scan a table QR code in their mobile browser to RSVP and share celebratory photos.

faqs.q1: How does the agency subdomain setup work?
faqs.a1: During agency workspace creation, you select your studio slug (e.g. "atelier-events"). Your client invitations, RSVP links, and couple dashboards immediately operate at atelier-events.eventframe.io with cookie isolation and custom branding.
faqs.q2: Will our couples see EventFrame branding or ads?
faqs.a2: No. On agency plans, client-facing pages (digital invitations, RSVP questionnaires, live reception display, and the couple portal) are presented cleanly with your studio identity and zero external advertisements.
faqs.q3: Can couples accidentally alter our agency settings?
faqs.a3: No. EventFrame enforces strict role separation. Couple portals are scoped exclusively to their individual wedding event via their unique access PIN. They cannot view your agency billing, other couples, or studio settings.
faqs.q4: Can we customize the look and feel for each individual couple?
faqs.a4: Yes. Each wedding event within your agency workspace can have its own Display Art Aesthetic (Natural Garden, Minimal Luxury, Romantic Love, Vintage Noir, and more) along with custom invitation canvas layouts.

faqs.q1: How do guests receive and open their digital invitation?
faqs.a1: Guests receive a clean web link (e.g., yourstudio.eventframe.io/wedding-name/invitation or eventframe.io/wedding-name/invitation). They can tap it on any mobile device without logging in or downloading an app.
faqs.q2: Can we change the invitation design after sending it out?
faqs.a2: Yes. Since EventFrame invitations are digital, you can update schedule details, shuttle departure times, or weather guidance at any moment. Changes reflect instantly for all guests.
faqs.q3: Does the invitation link directly to the RSVP questionnaire?
faqs.a3: Yes. The digital invitation includes an integrated RSVP button that transitions smoothly into your custom questions (dietary preferences, attendance headcount, transport options).
faqs.q4: Can we password-protect our digital wedding invitation?
faqs.a4: Yes. EventFrame allows you to set an optional access PIN so only invited friends and family can view ceremony details.

faqs.q1: Do guests need an account or password to submit an RSVP?
faqs.a1: No. Guests simply open the wedding RSVP link on their smartphone or computer, type their name, and answer the questions. The process takes less than 60 seconds.
faqs.q2: Can planners or couples add custom questions to the RSVP form?
faqs.a2: Yes. In the event configuration editor, you can create custom fields with custom labels, field types (dropdown, radio, checkbox, text, number), and mark them as required or optional.
faqs.q3: How are meal selections and dietary requirements tracked?
faqs.a3: All responses are logged in real-time in your workspace dashboard. You can review submissions by guest, filter by attending status, and export the entire dataset to CSV at any time.
faqs.q4: Can couples update an RSVP on behalf of a guest?
faqs.a4: Yes. Studio planners and couples can manually view, update, or edit guest RSVP details directly from the dashboard if someone calls or messages with changes.

faqs.q1: How does live message and photo moderation work?
faqs.a1: During the celebration, guests upload photos and notes from their phones. If auto-approve is disabled, submissions enter a live moderation queue in the dashboard where planners or couples can tap "Approve" or "Reject" before anything reaches the screen.
faqs.q2: Can couples check guest responses from their smartphones?
faqs.a2: Yes. The couple portal is fully responsive and touch-optimized. Couples can log in from their phones using their event access PIN to view attendee counts and approve live photos during the reception.
faqs.q3: Can we turn on auto-approve for trusted guest messages?
faqs.a3: Yes. In the event configuration settings, you can toggle "Auto-Approve Messages" on or off at any point during the event.
faqs.q4: Can guest lists be exported for place cards and caterers?
faqs.a4: Yes. You can export the entire guest list to CSV with names, attending status, party counts, meal preferences, and dietary requirements in seconds.

faqs.q1: What hardware is required to run the wedding reception display?
faqs.a1: Any standard laptop (Mac, Windows, or Chromebook) connected to a projector, large smart TV, or LED wall via HDMI or AirPlay. The display runs inside full-screen Chrome, Safari, or Edge.
faqs.q2: How quickly do guest photos appear on screen?
faqs.a2: Submissions sync in real-time. Once approved in the moderation dashboard, photos and notes animate onto the screen within seconds.
faqs.q3: What happens if venue Wi-Fi is slow?
faqs.a3: EventFrame uses lightweight vector styling and progressive image loading. Once the display URL is loaded in full-screen, incoming messages stream smoothly with low bandwidth consumption.
faqs.q4: Can couples download the full gallery of guest photos after the wedding?
faqs.a4: Yes. All submitted guest messages, candid reception photos, and timestamps are permanently stored in the couple portal for high-resolution download.
